_instructions: Default configuration, scoring weights, Xiaoming Trap rules, 5-tier alternative solution matrix, and Appendix F 20-item checklist for startup-idea-screener-skill.

tier_1_silent_endurance.label: No current solution (users silently endure)
tier_1_silent_endurance.opportunity: Potentially large, but requires expensive market education

tier_2_clumsy_manual_patch.label: Clumsy manual workaround (Excel, copy-paste, manual typing, human freelancers)
tier_2_clumsy_manual_patch.opportunity: Golden opportunity (Sweet Spot) — users already spend time/money

tier_3_multi_tool_stitching.label: Stitching multiple tools (Tool A + Tool B + Tool C)

tier_4_unsatisfied_incumbent.label: Mature product exists, but users complain about specific friction
tier_4_unsatisfied_incumbent.opportunity: Requires sharp 10x wedge on the broken step

tier_5_satisfied_incumbent.label: Mature product exists and users are satisfied
tier_5_satisfied_incumbent.opportunity: Low opportunity without disruptive innovation for an ignored segment
